what_the_seed_controls.lora_init: torch.manual_seed(seed) immediately before get_peft_model: LoRA A matrices (Kaiming-uniform) are drawn from it; B matrices are zero-initialised (seed-independent), so the initial adapter is the identity map for every seed
what_the_seed_controls.data_order: per epoch e: permutation default_rng(1000 * seed + 7 + e) of the examples, length-sorted inside chunks of 64 batches, batch order inside each chunk permuted by the same generator
what_the_seed_controls.dropout: LoRA dropout (p = 0.05) masks come from the torch CPU/CUDA generators seeded once at start (random.seed, np.random.seed, torch.manual_seed, torch.cuda.manual_seed_all)
what_the_seed_controls.not_controlled: GPU kernel non-determinism (bf16 sdpa / matmul reductions) and vLLM batch composition at inference; a seed-0 rerun is not bit-identical, so seed-to-seed spread includes this numerical noise
what_the_seed_controls.unchanged: the data set, targets, bundles, prompts, recipe, schedule, epochs, base weights, decoding and selection rule

freeze: For each arm: adapter sha256 (selected checkpoint) written to freeze_G_<list>.json before its test inference; each test prediction file (official {quid, ranked} format) sha256 recorded in multitq_kpct_seed_freeze_G.json and saved as an artifact BEFORE any test scoring. Test scoring is a separate CPU step that reads the frozen files and verifies their sha256 first.

analyses_registered.A1_per_seed: test Hits@1 (and Hits@10) of G_1_lora0/1/2 with 95% Poisson(1) bootstrap percentile CI (B = 2000, seed 0; multitq_eval.paired_poisson_bootstrap weights, identical for every full-test comparison)
analyses_registered.A2_seed_summary: mean, sample SD (ddof = 1) and range of test Hits@1 over LoRA seeds 0, 1, 2; and the seed-mean arm G_1_loramean = per-question mean hit over the three seeds (values 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), with its CI

A3_KP_recomputed.KP2: delta = G_1^seed - GU_1 on test Hits@1, paired over 54,584 questions; pass iff delta >= +0.020 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p < 0.05
A3_KP_recomputed.KP3: delta = G_1^seed - S_1 (per-question mean over the 3 LightGBM seeds); G_1 is the declared primary LLM arm at k = 1; pass iff delta >= +0.010 AND Holm-adjusted one-sided p < 0.05
A3_KP_recomputed.KP4: registered test delta = P_1 - S_1 on U_1 (n = 40,205) does not involve G and is reproduced unchanged; its registered descriptive companion G_1^seed - S_1 on U_1 is computed per seed (and for the seed-mean arm)
A3_KP_recomputed.Holm: per seed, Holm step-down over {KP2(seed), KP3(seed), KP4 (unchanged)}, family alpha 0.05, one-sided, exactly as the registered k = 1 family
A3_KP_recomputed.seed_mean: every KP above also for G_1_loramean (descriptive)
A3_KP_recomputed.k5: KP2 at k = 5 is NOT_RUN (GU_5, fallback 2); KP3 at k = 5 uses the declared primary P_5 and is unchanged; G_5^seed - S_5 is descriptive (only if G_5 seeds run)

analyses_registered.A4_seed_label: per KP contrast: SEED_STABLE iff every LoRA seed's 95% CI excludes 0 in the same direction as seed 0, else SEED_SENSITIVE (for KP4 applied to the G companion; the P-based test is seed-independent). Also reported: whether the pass/fail label (threshold + Holm) is identical across seeds (descriptive).
analyses_registered.A5_KP1: G_1^seed vs AT2QA 0.887: ABOVE (CI lower > 0.887) / BELOW (CI upper < 0.887) / TIE, per seed and seed-mean; the other comparators (ORACLE-T 0.869, TKG-Thinker 0.855, SCoP 0.825) descriptive
analyses_registered.A6_G5_vs_P5: descriptive per seed: G_5^seed - P_5 (P_5 = per-question mean over its 3 S seeds), paired bootstrap; NOT_RUN with the G_5 seeds
analyses_registered.A7_strata: G_1^seed test Hits@1 per qlabel (Single / Multiple) and answer_type (entity / time), per seed and seed-mean, Poisson bootstrap CI B = 1000 (descriptive)
analyses_registered.A8_dev: dev_sel2000 Hits@1 of every checkpoint per seed and the selected checkpoint (selection transparency)
analyses_registered.outputs: multitq_kpct_seed_freeze_G.json, multitq_kpct_seed_results_G.json, per-question CSV keyed by quid with G_1_lora0@1, G_1_lora1@1, G_1_lora2@1, G_1_loramean@1 and the @10 columns (G_5_* columns only if run), multitq_kpct_seed_report_G.md, code tarball
